mechanical_checks.go_build_information_only: go1.27.1, CGO0, trimpath, darwin/arm64, exactly three original modules with fixed local replacements

source_review: Exactly three direct dispatch branches: datasize.UnmarshalText, query.Values, shlex.Split; literal specification fixes 10/6/8 probes. Helper/getter/internal calls are not separate primary API counts.

Worker verifies runtime CPU1/soft heap, fixed budgets and qualification=false, source/Want/binary pins before dispatch. Literal Want byte equality is against the compiled pure specification. Root controller verifies the exact 21-entry ordered closure.

New attempt directory, O_EXCL reservation.json and reserved final results.json precede direct API dispatch. Files and child directory are fsynced. Before each call, DispatchReserved and ActiveProbeID are saved through a fsynced temporary file, atomic rename, and child-directory fsync.

A failed pre-call checkpoint prevents that callback. Returns and wrapper panics are distinct; a saved prefix may have exactly one reserved in-flight call. Post-return and final checkpoints preserve differences without rewriting Want.
Nil and allocated-empty token slices/maps remain observable. Query keys are sorted but repeated value order is preserved. Returned observations and copied Want arrays are owned independently.

Panic payloads and unclassified error strings are redacted. Accepted classified error text refers only to fixed public probe inputs. CLI errors are fixed strings. No stdin/env/FS-execution API or actor callback is dispatched.
Complete finite differences exit normally and remain differences. No general no-panic guarantee, new parent labels, or caption/training approval is inferred.
trust_and_limits: Reviewer authored the preceding source inventory/import-build preparation, not this observer. Observer mechanics review is independent of observer authorship but is not blind and is not independent source-origin proof. Want semantic review is performed separately.
The observer is reviewed behind the exact frozen root controller, not as a general untrusted-plan runner; its standalone JSON/closure checks are narrower than the controller checks.

Imported Go package initialization runs before worker main after child Start. Source-visible initializers are read-only observations, not dynamically instrumented counts and not part of the 24 direct API counters.

Last synced partial prefix is the available evidence after process termination. The newly created child directory entry is not separately fsynced in its parent by the worker; universal power-loss durability is not asserted.

Outside 60-second kill/Wait and nullable whole-child resource fields are controller responsibilities. Heap setting is soft, RSS is observed rather than hard-capped. No resource performance claim is established here.
Source/binary SHA and trusted compiler metadata do not formally prove a trusted compiler. No original API result, model quality, exhaustive behavior, or generalization claim is established.
